In brief

  • The Wild Card runs December 17–20, 2026 in Bangkok: 10 teams play for 3 main stage places.
  • The main stage is in Istanbul: Swiss January 3–10, 2027, playoffs January 14–19.
  • The grand final is on January 23, the prize pool is $1 000 000.
  • CIS is represented by Team Spirit, Aurevia Team and Team Yandex.

How M8 works

M8 World Championship stages
StageDatesFormatWho goes on
Wild Card, groupsDecember 17–182 groups of 5 teams, Bo1first place in each group goes straight to the main stage
Wild Card, playoffsDecember 19–20second and third places, Bo5 knockoutthe winner goes to the main stage
SwissJanuary 3–1016 teams, 5 rounds3 wins earn a playoff place, 3 losses mean elimination
PlayoffsJanuary 14–19double elimination, Bo3 and Bo52 teams reach the grand final
Grand finalJanuary 23Bo7M8 champion

Wild Card matches follow Bangkok time, 4 hours ahead of Moscow: a 13:10 start in Bangkok is 09:10 in Moscow. Istanbul shares Moscow time, so main stage matches start at 13:00 or later.

CIS teams at M8

Team Spirit won MCC Season 8 4:0 against Aurevia Team and starts straight in the Swiss stage. It is the same team that won MSC 2026 in the summer. Aurevia Team and Team Yandex start in the Wild Card: only 3 of 10 teams there reach the main stage.

MCT SEA qualifier

MCT SEA, ICONSIAM, Bangkok
DatesStageWhat is decided
9–10 DecemberGroup stage12 teams from 11 countries in four groups
10 DecemberLast Chance QualifierOne BO1 match for the last playoff place
11–13 DecemberPlayoffsplaces 1–2 go to the M8 Main Stage, places 3–4 to the Wild Card

The MCT SEA prize pool is $50,000.

MCT SEA will decide the last 4 participants. The Wild Card group draw is set for December 14, after which the groups appear in the schedule at the top of the page.

FAQ

When does MLBB M8 start?

The Wild Card starts on December 17, 2026 in Bangkok, the main stage on January 3, 2027 in Istanbul.

When is the M8 final?

The grand final is set for January 23, 2027 in Istanbul.

What is the M8 prize pool?

The total M8 prize pool is $1 000 000.

Which CIS teams play at M8?

Team Spirit is in the main stage as MCC Season 8 champion. Aurevia Team and Team Yandex start in the Wild Card.

Where can I watch M8 in Russian?

On Twitch mlbb_cis, on YouTube @MLBB_MCC and @mlbbcis, on VK Video mlbbesports.
